defs.def: a group of sports teams who all play each other to earn points and find which team is best （体育运动队的）联合会，联赛

ex.s: The National Basketball Association (NBA) is the main professional basketball league in the United States.
ex.t: NBA（国家篮球协会）是美国主要的职业篮球联赛。

ex.s: Find out what the author intends to tell us.] TWENTY THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE SEA In 1866, a terrible sea creature is seen by several ships.
ex.t: 弄清作者想告诉我们什么：《海底两万里》——1866年，几艘船发现了一只可怕的海怪。

defs.def: a level of quality, ability, etc. （质量、能力等的）等级，级别，水平
a group of people or nations who have combined for a particular purpose 联盟；同盟

ex.s: It was formed in 1946 as the Basketball Association of America and renamed as the National Basketball Association when it merged with the National Basketball League in 1949.
ex.t: 它于1946年作为美国篮球协会成立，并在1949年与全国篮球联盟合并后更名为国家篮球协会。

defs.def: a unit for measuring distance, equal to about 3 miles or 4 000 metres 里格（长度单位，约等于 3 英里或 4 000 米）

ex.s: Verne’s most famous books are Journey to the Centre of the Earth (1864), Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea (1870) and Around the World in Eighty Days (1873).
ex.t: 凡尔纳最著名的书是《地心游记》（1864）、《海底两万里》（1870）和《八十天环游地球》（1873）。
